compatibility_checks.method: Search the theorem proof, its retained-data map R_plus, declared guards, source evidence, and locally banked Schwarzschild/OS/LTB candidates for a pair of inequivalent a=0 marked developments that satisfy the same complete theorem domain and have exactly equal images under the complete retained-data map. Reject Birkhoff exterior uniqueness, a single Oppenheimer-Snyder construction, a merely local collar, or an equality of only selected observables as insufficient.
inputs_and_assumptions: The source theorem's full horizon/interior class, markings, regularity, junction, and retained-data guards are held fixed.
Gauge-related or diffeomorphic representatives do not count as inequivalent witnesses.
The existing nonzero-spin Kerr transverse-traceless witness is not silently transported to a=0.
compatibility_checks.proof_obligation: Exhibit two gauge/diffeomorphism-inequivalent a=0 marked developments, each satisfying every theorem guard and legal junction condition, with identical values of every component of the complete retained-data map R_plus.
compatibility_checks.result: The current bank contains Schwarzschild/OS constructions, Birkhoff uniqueness statements, LTB variants, and the accepted nonzero-spin Kerr witness, but no artifact meets the paired full-R_plus a=0 obligation. Birkhoff constrains a vacuum exterior rather than supplying two interiors; one OS construction supplies no noninjective pair; and no checked LTB record proves equality under the theorem's complete retained-data map with all legal junction and marking guards.
compatibility_checks.limitation: This is an absence result over the current governed bank, not a theorem that no Schwarzschild witness exists.
compatibility_checks.resolution_route: Construct or import an exact zero-spin remote-pocket/collar pair, prove legal junctions and full theorem-domain membership, evaluate every R_plus component, and prove gauge/diffeomorphism inequivalence before rerunning the branch gate.
